comments.comment:
The reason of problem is that one of listeners expects expression

 

"default2 - size before/after: (\\S+)/\\1"

But output for CLI handler is

Defragmentation is completed for cache groups:
    default3 - size before/after: 0MB/0MB, time took: 0 mins 0 secs
    default1 - size before/after: 0MB/0MB, time took: 0 mins 0 secs
    default2 - size before/after: 44MB/44.02MB, time took: 0 mins 12 secs

And 44MB and 44.02MB  are not equals. It looks like the size increased after defragmentation.

Moreover, it depends on CommandHandler. If we run with JmxCommandHandler, everything is ok and output is 

default2 - size before/after: 44.02MB/44.02MB

And the problem appears if we run CliCommandHandler.

If we add delay before starting defragmentation for JMX handler, there also will be same problem

default2 - size before/after: 44MB/44.02MB, time took: 0 mins 12 secs
It looks like total size of index pages before defragmentation is 0 bytes and becomes 24576 bytes (~0,02 mb) after defragmentation. 24576 bytes equals to 6 pages

The problem was that CachePartitionDefragmentationManager took total size of old index pages after index defragmentation and the size could be zero. Now it takes the size before starting index defragmentation
